row.title: Release note for 0.42
row.text:
# Release note for 0.42

Armada 0.42 draws each tool call on a row of its own. A row shows what the call is, how long it ran, and where it stopped.

## What changed

A Job that stops keeps its slot until you press Release. The retry press now waits for the slot to free before it starts the Job again.

- Rows keep their time after the Job is done.
- A failed call says where it failed.

| Call | Row shows | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Read | The path | Kept |
| Bash | The first line of the command | Kept |

## Known gaps

Calls inside a subagent draw in its own tab, not in the thread.
